title: "Dont Tell Chum Bout the Bet": The Disputed Text

lines.say: Dont tell Chum bout the bet. Chum is Terry Rozier's nickname. And this one text may decide his case.
lines.show: "Dont tell Chum bout the bet." "Chum" is Terry Rozier's nickname. And this one text may decide his case.

lines.say: Laster sent that text from Philadelphia. The defense says it proves Rozier never knew about the bets.
